method: Saved Chinese and Japanese paragraphs reread side by side in full, 231 of 231. Translation follows Chinese, not the compressed English reconstruction.

findings.result: Preserved actual acquisition versus approach, the same cut producing its remainder, the fallibility of outside questioning, defensibility versus correctness of compulsion, and Socrates qualifying his own interpretation rather than the image.
Kept not speaking today distinct from in-principle unsayability, source from operation, standing from production. Corrected the unnatural expression for the sentence leaving the mouth.

Preserved unequal division as the first visible appearance of hierarchy, not its origin. Changed quadrilateral to square and corrected the Japanese spelling of hypothesis. All four kinds of shortfall, wardrobe and knowledge examples, nonexhaustiveness and nonexclusiveness remain.

Preserved the loss of external questioning, declining thresholds rather than increasing counts, skill and driving examples, descriptive invoice versus command, and all three reverse questions. Restored explicit younger/older wording rather than silently neutralizing the Chinese age relation.

Checked transversal temperance, all conditions of the noncontradiction rule, the declared shortcut, sixteen stages, nonadoption rather than suppression, and continuity of the same subject across interruption. Removed an unwarranted specification of shogi for generic Chinese board play.

source_questions.question: Relative seniority of Adeimantus and Glaucon uncertain, not a confirmed factual error. An editorial source check found divergent modern descriptions and overlapping dates, so Chinese younger/older wording is preserved and this is not a publication blocker.

limitations: Full Chinese-source translation review, not independent philological verification of the Greek original.
